_comment: Auntie Musu's story. Each step has a type handled by proto3d/game/missions.gd: deliver_any_car, goto (optional timer), lose_police, destroy_vehicle, steal_vehicle, deliver_vehicle. Places refer to ids in places_src.json.

missions.title: Wheels for the Crew
missions.intro: Welcome back to Monrovia, Kollie. My crew needs wheels. Take any car and bring it to our garage at Slipway.

steps.text: Take any car {p3_interact} and bring it to the crew garage at Slipway.

missions.title: Waterfront Pickup
missions.intro: A package is waiting for me at West Point Market. Collect it and get it to the Nancy B. Doe Market in Sinkor. You get two and a half minutes once it's in your hands.

steps.text: Go to West Point Market to collect the package.
Deliver the package to the Nancy B. Doe Market!

missions.title: Heat on Capitol Hill
missions.intro: Police are asking questions about the garage. I told them it was you. Draw them away and lose them.

steps.text: Lose the police. Break their line of sight, or use a respray shop.

missions.title: Sinkor Rival
missions.intro: The Fiamah boys keep sending a red sports car to scare my drivers in Sinkor. Find it and wreck it.

steps.text: Find the red sports car around Fiamah and wreck it (ram it or shoot it).

missions.title: The Big Score
missions.intro: An armoured van is parked on a back street in Sinkor. Take it and bring it to the wharf at Slipway. Police will come fast.

steps.text: Steal the armoured van in Sinkor.
Get the van to the Slipway wharf!

finale: Monrovia is yours now, Kollie. Thanks for playing this LibGamer demo!
